pr.title: ArchiMate overlay: dth-hrh owns the NHWA work (CS-007)
pr.body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"litlfred"} -->
_Requested by **litlfred** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_017WNUkNK8kdDziPK58Pv6G9?thread=cmsg_017WNUkNK8kdDziPK58Pv6G98q7ycpNcyZETyhTTp9ETxW)_

Part of #47 (CS-007), bean `dth-hrh-s8rm` and the overlay step of `dth-hrh-w5sp` in the signed-off plan (#75). The owner chose to start the overlay (Q-L2P-4 A), then ruled on 2026-11-01 at 20:32Z that NHWA does not belong in smart-ra: "close out that possibility", "then make dth overlay".

## What
- **`archimate/0.1.0-draft.1/dth-hrh-overlay.archimate`**: the dth-hrh overlay on smart-ra 0.2.0.
  - 17 items owned by dth-hrh (`overlay:owner`): CDE-HWR, the NHWA Dataset, the four NHWA modules, the subnational density indicators, and their relationships.
  - 78 reference copies of smart-ra elements (`overlay:base`), with smart-ra's own names.
  - One view, "Health workforce registry and NHWA (dth-hrh)". It is smart-ra 0.2.0 view 1 as smart-ra#188 drew it, with its own id and `overlay:derived-from`.
- **`scripts/archimate/extract_overlay.py`** builds it from smart-ra#188's staged model. `archimate/README.md` and `cat-archimate.config.json` describe it, and `dth-hrh.json` declares the served `archimate/` directory.
- **6 blocks** (Ch 4 key messages, Ch 5 priority use cases, FR-AN-02, FR-REC-01, Ch 7 analytics and records) linked CDE-HWR and NHWA Dataset as smart-ra 0.2.0 items. smart-ra#187 had removed those, so the links no longer resolved; they now link the overlay. This changes link metadata only, no prose, and the block JSON-LD is regenerated.
- **Re-pin:** dpi-h-ra moves to smart-ra 7aaec92 (after #187), the same pin as #69. The lock also catches up with the config's cat-harness-tools 3aeaeed, which main's config already pins.
- **`docs/l2-wiring.md`**: new step 5, the ArchiMate overlay.
- **NHWA poster figure** (owner, 20:32Z: "make view poster from model of the nhwa and put into paper"): a banded overlay view, drawn by `archimate-blocks` as a poster into `media/nhwa-poster.svg`, becomes `fig:nhwa-poster` in 7.5 Analytics. It adds a figure to the handbook, so it is content for the working group.

Related: smart-ra#188 is closed. Draft smart-ra#221 takes the same NHWA items out of 0.3.0-draft.1. #69 dropped its own changes to these 6 links.

## Checks
- `check-archimate --instance .`: the overlay parses and resolves.
- `check:dth-glossary`: passes. The 6 overlay links are reported "not checked", because the shared validator in folio-assistant-core reads only mounted instances' models, not the folio's own, and it has no overlay-tag checks yet. dth-phc has those checks locally. Moving them into core is the follow-up.
- `check:kg-blocks` (322 up to date), `check:review-anchors` (current).

Draft: the NHWA view and links are for the working group to review. Not merged without the owner's word.
